item.description: 腾讯游戏安全竞赛 2016 安卓方向初赛与决赛题目的逆向分析与解题过程
item.content:encoded:
题目链接: https://gslab.qq.com/competition/firstTurn.shtml

10年前的题目长的真是眉清目秀🫠

初赛题目

题目描述

Tencent2016A 是一个简单的注册程序，见附件，请写一个注册机，点击Check即可显示是否通过, Name和Code可以手动输入,也可以通过扫描二维码输入。

解题过程

java层逻辑很简单，判断一下输入Name的长度在6~20以内，然后直接调用native层的 NativeCheckRegister 函数进行check

package com.tencent.tencent2016a;

import android.view.View;

/* JADX INFO: loaded from: classes.dex */
class c implements View.OnClickListener {
    final /* synthetic */ MainActivity a;

    c(MainActivity mainActivity) {
        this.a = mainActivity;
    }

    @Override // android.view.View.OnClickListener
    public void onClick(View view) {
        String name = this.a.q.getText().toString();
        String code = this.a.r.getText().toString();
        if (name.length() < 6 || name.length() > 20) {
            this.a.s.setMessage("Name too short(<6) or too long(>20)!");
        } else if (1 == this.a.NativeCheckRegister(name, code)) {
            this.a.s.setMessage("Check Success!");
        } else {
            this.a.s.setMessage("Check Fail!");
        }
        this.a.s.create().show();

Native 层逻辑也很清晰：先校验 name 长度（6~20），再根据 name 生成 20 字节 hash，接着 Base64 解码 code，要求解码后长度必须为 20。

两边都拆成 5 个 DWORD，hash 会先做有符号整除 10。由于 Python 与 C 在整除行为上存在差异，写脚本时需要特殊处理

最后解一组简单的线性方程即可

bool __fastcall check(const char *name, unsigned __int8 *code)
{
  signed int name_size; // r5
  _BOOL4 result; // r0
  int i; // r4
  _DWORD *p_hash; // r7
  int temp; // r3
  int j; // r4
  int dword; // r1
  _DWORD hash_div10[5]; // [sp+18h] [bp-444h] BYREF
  _DWORD dwords[5]; // [sp+2Ch] [bp-430h] BYREF
  _BYTE hash[20]; // [sp+40h] [bp-41Ch] BYREF
  _BYTE decode_code[1032]; // [sp+54h] [bp-408h] BYREF

  name_size = j_strlen(a1: name);
  if ( (unsigned int)(name_size - 6) > 14 )
    return false;
  j_memset(a1: hash, a2: 0, a3: sizeof(hash));
  for ( i = 0; i != 16; ++i )
  {
    p_hash = &hash[i];
    temp = (unsigned __int8)name[i % name_size] * (i + 20160126) * name_size;
    *p_hash += temp;
  }
  j_memset(a1: decode_code, a2: 0, a3: 0x400u);
  if ( CalcBase64DecodedSize(code) > 1024 || Base64Decode(out: decode_code, in: code) != 20 )
    return false;
  j_memset(a1: hash_div10, a2: 0, a3: sizeof(hash_div10));
  j_memset(a1: dwords, a2: 0, a3: sizeof(dwords));
  for ( j = 0; j != 5; ++j )
  {
    dword = *(_DWORD *)&decode_code[j * 4];
    hash_div10[j] = *(_DWORD *)&hash[j * 4] / 10;
    dwords[j] = dword;
  }
  result = false;
  if ( dwords[4] + hash_div10[0] == dwords[2]
    && dwords[4] + hash_div10[0] + hash_div10[1] == 2 * dwords[4]
    && hash_div10[2] + dwords[3] == dwords[0]
    && hash_div10[2] + dwords[3] + hash_div10[3] == 2 * dwords[3] )
  {
    return hash_div10[4] + dwords[1] == 3 * hash_div10[2];
  }
  return result;
}

解题脚本

import base64
import struct

name = "testtest"
# code = "MTExMTExMTExMTExMTExMTExMTE="
name_size = len(name)
hash = bytearray(20)

for i in range(16):
    old = int.from_bytes(hash[i : i + 4], "little")
    v7 = (ord(name[i % name_size]) * (i + 20160126) * name_size) & 0xffffffff
    hash[i : i + 4] = ((old + v7) & 0xffffffff).to_bytes(4, "little")

# decoded = base64.b64decode(code)

hash_div10 = [0] * 5
dwords = [0] * 5

def idiv(a, b):
    a = (a & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    if a >= 0x80000000:
        a -= 0x100000000
    return int(a / b)

for i in range(5):
    hash_div10[i] = idiv(int.from_bytes(hash[i * 4 : (i + 1) * 4], "little"), 10)
    # dwords[i] = int.from_bytes(decoded[i * 4 : (i + 1) * 4], "little")

h0, h1, h2, h3, h4 = (i for i in hash_div10)
# d0, d1, d2, d3, d4 = (i for i in dwords)
d0, d1, d2, d3, d4 = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0

d4 = (h0 + h1) & 0xffffffff
d3 = (h2 + h3) & 0xffffffff
d2 = (h0 + d4) & 0xffffffff
d1 = (3 * h2 - h4) & 0xffffffff
d0 = (h2 + d3) & 0xffffffff
raw = b"".join(struct.pack("<I", value) for value in (d0, d1, d2, d3, d4))
reg_code = base64.b64encode(raw).decode("utf-8")
print(reg_code)

决赛题目

题目有三个，1和3是尽可能多的实现反调试和检测Root的方式，这里只选择第二个KeyGenMe题目做分析了

题目描述

Tencent2016C是一个简单的注册程序，见附件，请写一个注册机，注册机的输入为设备ID字符串(界面内的二维码同设备ID字符串内容一致),输出为二维码形式的注册号。

题目分析

java层的逻辑为：扫描二维码后，将得到的 Base64 数据解码为 32 字节，使用硬编码的 RSA 公钥解密。

解密结果的前两个字节被解析为长度，随后提取对应长度的数据。调用 native 方法 NativeCheckRegister，传入生成的 device_id 与提取出的 20 字节数据

因为长度要求为 20，所以解密后的前两个字节必然是 00 14

native层的算法常量很清晰，也没有被魔改

bool __fastcall check(char *device_id, const void *code)
{
  int v3; // r4
  size_t device_id_size; // r0
  uint8_t *sha1_data; // r5
  size_t device_id_size_; // r0
  _BYTE subkeys[272]; // [sp+14h] [bp-5D0h] BYREF
  _DWORD des_key[2]; // [sp+124h] [bp-4C0h] BYREF
  int v11; // [sp+12Ch] [bp-4B8h] BYREF
  int v12; // [sp+130h] [bp-4B4h]
  _QWORD data[2]; // [sp+134h] [bp-4B0h] BYREF
  _QWORD aes_key[2]; // [sp+144h] [bp-4A0h] BYREF
  uint8_t aes_state[16]; // [sp+154h] [bp-490h] BYREF
  _DWORD expected[5]; // [sp+164h] [bp-480h] BYREF
  _BYTE ctx[96]; // [sp+178h] [bp-46Ch] BYREF
  _DWORD result[258]; // [sp+1DCh] [bp-408h] BYREF

  v3 = 0;
  if ( j_strlen(a1: device_id) - 6 <= 94 )
  {
    j_memset(a1: expected, a2: 0, a3: sizeof(expected));
    j_memset(a1: ctx, a2: 0, a3: sizeof(ctx));
    sha1_init(ctx);
    device_id_size = j_strlen(a1: device_id);
    sha1_update(ctx, data: device_id, size: device_id_size + 1);// 注意这里长度加了1,所以计算包含了末尾的\x00
    sha1_data = sha1_final(ctx);
    j_memset(a1: data, a2: 0, a3: sizeof(data));
    j_memset(a1: aes_key, a2: 0, a3: sizeof(aes_key));
    *data = *sha1_data;
    *aes_key = *(sha1_data + 4);
    j_memset(a1: aes_state, a2: 0, a3: sizeof(aes_state));
    AES_Decrypt(data, key: aes_key, state: aes_state);// aes decrypt
    qmemcpy(expected, aes_state, 16);
    device_id_size_ = j_strlen(a1: device_id);
    expected[4] = crc32(buf: device_id, size: device_id_size_);// 这里计算crc的时候不包含末尾\x00
    j_memset(a1: result, a2: 0, a3: 0x400u);
    j_memcpy(a1: result, a2: code, a3: 20u);
    des_key[0] = 0x13235D3F;
    des_key[1] = result[4];
    j_memset(a1: subkeys, a2: 0, a3: sizeof(subkeys));
    DES_KeySchedule(key: des_key, subkeys);
    v11 = 0;
    v12 = 0;
    DES(input: result, output: &v11, subkeys, a4: 0);// des decrypt
    result[0] = v11;
    result[1] = v12;
    DES(input: &result[2], output: &v11, subkeys, a4: 0);
    result[2] = v11;
    result[3] = v12;
    return j_memcmp(a1: result, a2: expected, a3: 20u) == 0;
  }
  return v3;
}

大致逻辑为

   aes_dec(sha1(device_id)[0:16], sha1(device_id)[4:20]) + crc32(device_id) 
== des_dec(code[0:16], "3F5D2313" + crc32(device_id))  + crc32(device_id)

解题

java层的RSA用的是公钥解密 $M=C^e\bmod n$

那么加密回去则需要用私钥 $C=M^d\bmod n$

但公钥中只有 $n$ 和 $e$

import base64

from Crypto.PublicKey import RSA

pbk = "MDwwDQYJKoZIhvcNAQEBBQADKwAwKAIhAMw8CJ6Azv7ak+y+AEJmen4UMMPkGQ5D2QBrG7vKcX6XAgMBAAE="

key = RSA.import_key(base64.b64decode(pbk))
n, e = key.n, key.e

print(n, e)
# 92377891422080520374820400579771977245937984366175935318313202287429727387287 65537

所以需要先分解$n$，得到$p$和$q$，直接查factordb

p = 298189805342220294696804713023137542429
q = 309795605909672789868308887071174440003

然后计算得到$d$： $d=e^{-1}\bmod\varphi(n)$

from Crypto.Util.number import inverse

p = 298189805342220294696804713023137542429
q = 309795605909672789868308887071174440003

n = p * q
e = 65537

phi = (p - 1) * (q - 1)

d = inverse(e, phi)

print("n =", n)
print("e =", e)
print("d =", d)
# n = 92377891422080520374820400579771977245937984366175935318313202287429727387287
# e = 65537
# d = 14835547968588697635610185331981934792668236858577224232268773874821936419673

native层唯一需要注意的点就是计算sha1的时候，size是加了1的，所以包含末尾的00字节，会影响sha1的结果，而后面的crc不包含

sha1_update(ctx, data: device_id, size: device_id_size + 1);

                emulator,
                0x1661,
                device_id,
                data
        ).intValue();

        System.out.println("ret = " + ret);
    }
}

import base64
import binascii
import hashlib

from Crypto.Cipher import AES, DES
from Crypto.Util.number import inverse

device_id = b"5dad0d73-5727-f5ba-a3ac-213fa9e2c00c"

sha1_data = hashlib.sha1(device_id + b"\x00").digest()

aes_key = sha1_data[4:20]
aes_data = AES.new(aes_key,AES.MODE_ECB).decrypt(sha1_data[:16])

crc = binascii.crc32(device_id) & 0xFFFFFFFF
crc_bytes = crc.to_bytes(4, "little")

des_key = bytes.fromhex("3F5D2313") + crc_bytes
des_data = DES.new(des_key,DES.MODE_ECB).encrypt(aes_data)

code_data = des_data + crc_bytes

# RSA
p = 298189805342220294696804713023137542429
q = 309795605909672789868308887071174440003

n = p * q
e = 65537
phi = (p - 1) * (q - 1)
d = inverse(e, phi)

# 00 14 | 20 bytes code | 10 bytes padding
block = b"\x00\x14" + code_data + b"\x00" * 10

m = int.from_bytes(block, "big")
c = pow(m, d, n)

code = base64.b64encode(c.to_bytes(32, "big")).decode()

print(code)
